name: Corporate Action Event Processing Status 1 Code
definition: Specifies the stage in the corporate action event life cycle.

COMP.name: Complete
COMP.definition: Specifies that a corporate action event processing has been completed.

PEND.name: Pending
PEND.definition: Specifies that a corporate action event processing has not been completed.

RECD.name: Reconciled
RECD.definition: Corporate action event processing specifying that the funds paid have been reconciled with the funds received from the agent (meaning that there is no more risk of payment to be reversed).
